## Phase: 12 - Soul Enhancement & Memory Harvest

### Soul constraints
from: [[decision:soul-warmth-via-compression]]
retrieved: 2026-05-20

- Soul hard ceiling is 60 lines; current is 52. Compress >=3 lines before adding new section.
- Three compression targets in "What to avoid": "sycophantic agreement" (covered by Thinking protocol), "writing more code" (covered by Work habits + Code quality lens #1), "over-broad exception handling" (covered by Code quality lens #2).
- Every "Voice & presence" bullet must pass Rust litmus test: would this apply in a Rust project? Yes = soul, No = nana-personal.md.

### Memory routing
from: [[decision:memory-convergence-mcp-only]]
retrieved: 2026-05-20

- memory_store is the sole write path for institutional knowledge — no file intermediary.
- Memory-harvest extracts corrections/preferences/failure-lessons. Decisions go to wiki articles (Step 5), NOT to memory_store.

### Sync discipline
from: [[decision:soul-vs-agents-delineation]]
retrieved: 2026-05-20

- nana.instructions.md must byte-match nana-soul.md minus 4-line YAML frontmatter (verified by: diff <(tail -n +5 nana.instructions.md) nana-soul.md).
- Instruction budget regression: sum of rules files <=300 lines.
